
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>KustelinhaTCG — Loja de Cartas Pokémon</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;}
:root{
  --blue:#1a6db5;--blue-dk:#124f87;--blue-lt:#1a2e4a;
  --yellow:#f5c518;--yel-dk:#c9a000;
  --red:#cc2200;--white:#f0f4ff;--off:#1e4068;
  --black:#f0f4ff;--muted:#a8c0d8;--border:#3a6090;
  --wa:#25d366;--wa-dk:#1da851;
  --r-c:#7a8fa8;--r-u:#28a062;--r-r:#1a6db5;
  --r-ur:#7c3aed;--r-sr:#c9a000;--r-pr:#cc2200;
  --fs-xl:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4rem);--fs-lg:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem);
  --fs-md:1rem;--fs-sm:0.875rem;--fs-xs:0.75rem;--sec:5rem;
  --bg-page:#1a3a5e;
  --bg-card:#234872;
  --bg-card2:#1e4068;
}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--bg-page);color:var(--black);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
.container{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;width:100%;min-width:0;}
.label{font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}
.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.sec-head h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:400;line-height:1.2;}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:600;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;}
.btn-yellow{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--black);border-color:var(--yellow);}
.btn-yellow:hover{background:var(--yel-dk);border-color:var(--yel-dk);}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--white);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
.btn-outline:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);}
.btn-blue{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);}
.btn-blue:hover{background:var(--blue-dk);}
.btn-wa{background:var(--wa);color:var(--white);}
.btn-wa:hover{background:var(--wa-dk);}

/* ─── NAV ─── */
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:var(--blue);border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow);}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:80px;gap:1rem;}
.nav-logo{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--white);white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.nav-logo svg{height:68px;width:auto;max-width:260px;}
.nav-logo span{color:var(--yellow);}
.nav-logo small{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);display:block;margin-top:-4px;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:.15rem;list-style:none;}
.nav-links a{font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:4px;transition:color .15s,background .15s;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
.nav-wa{background:var(--wa);color:var(--white);font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s;}
.nav-wa:hover{background:var(--wa-dk);}
.nav-wa svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:var(--white);}

/* ─── HERO ─── */
.hero{background:var(--blue);border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow);padding:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
/* pokémons no fundo */
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);opacity:.07;}
.hero-bg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3.5rem;filter:grayscale(1) brightness(2);}
/* imagem topo - coleção Caos Ascendente */
.hero-banner{
  width:100%;
  height:320px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
}
.hero-banner img{
  width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;
  display:block;
}
.hero-banner svg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;
}
.hero-banner-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(26,109,181,.2) 0%,rgba(18,79,135,.65) 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-start;
  padding:1.5rem 2rem;
}
.hero-banner-tag{
  background:var(--yellow);color:var(--black);
  font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:4px;
}
.hero-banner-fallback{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0e3a6e 0%,#1a6db5 50%,#0e3a6e 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;
}
.hero-banner-fallback span{font-size:5rem;opacity:.4;}
.hero-banner-fallback p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);font-size:var(--fs-sm);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;}
/* conteúdo hero */
.hero-content-row{padding:3rem 0 3.5rem;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4rem;align-items:center;}
.hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:1.25rem;}
.hero-eyebrow::before{content:'';display:block;width:18px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
.hero h1{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:var(--fs-xl);font-weight:400;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:1.4rem;}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--yellow);}
.hero-desc{font-size:var(--fs-md);color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);max-width:430px;line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:2rem;}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hero-visual{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;}
.card-showcase{background:var(--blue-dk);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.card-showcase::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-30px;right:-30px;width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,197,24,.1);}
.card-stack{position:relative;height:88px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.75rem;}
.c-mock{position:absolute;width:62px;height:86px;border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.8rem;}
.c-mock:nth-child(1){background:#1a3d22;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);transform:rotate(-9deg) translateX(-34px);z-index:1;}
.c-mock:nth-child(2){background:var(--blue-dk);border:2px solid var(--yellow);transform:rotate(-1deg);z-index:2;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
.c-mock:nth-child(3){background:#4a1208;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);transform:rotate(8deg) translateX(34px);z-index:1;}
.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;}
.h-stat{background:var(--blue-dk);padding:.875rem;text-align:center;}
.h-stat-num{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.5rem;display:block;color:var(--yellow);margin-bottom:2px;}
.h-stat-lbl{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}

/* ─── STRIP ─── */
.strip{background:var(--blue-dk);border-bottom:2px solid var(--yellow);padding:.875rem 0;overflow:hidden;}
.strip-row{display:flex;gap:2.5rem;white-space:nowrap;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);}
.strip-row b{color:var(--yellow);}

/* ─── SEÇÃO CARTAS EM DESTAQUE ─── */
.featured-cards{background:var(--blue-dk);border-bottom:3px solid var(--yellow);padding:3.5rem 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.feat-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;}
.feat-bg::before,.feat-bg::after{
  content:'👻  🐉  ⚡  🔥  💧  🌿';
  position:absolute;font-size:9rem;opacity:.035;
  letter-spacing:3rem;white-space:nowrap;filter:grayscale(1) brightness(2);
}
.feat-bg::before{top:-10px;left:-20px;}
.feat-bg::after{bottom:-10px;right:-20px;}
.featured-cards .container{position:relative;z-index:1;}
/* ── CARROSSEL ── */
.carousel-sec{padding:2.5rem 0 2rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a1a 0%,#0d1428 100%);overflow:hidden;}
.carousel-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.carousel-head .label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-bottom:.4rem;display:block;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.carousel-head h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;line-height:1.2;}
.carousel-head h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--yellow);}
.carousel-wrap{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;}
.carousel-track{display:flex;gap:.75rem;overflow-x:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth;padding:.75rem .25rem;flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:100%;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(255,215,0,.3) transparent;cursor:grab;}
.carousel-track:active{cursor:grabbing;}
.carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar{height:4px;}
.carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
.carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,215,0,.3);border-radius:2px;}
.carousel-card{flex:0 0 110px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius:10px;padding:.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;}
.carousel-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.04);border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.5);}
.carousel-card img{width:90px;height:126px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:5px;display:block;}
.carousel-card .cc-name{font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);text-align:center;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;width:100%;}
.carousel-card .cc-price{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--yellow);}
.cc-num{font-size:.5rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-left:3px;opacity:.85;}
.carousel-card .cc-promo{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b44cff,#7c3aed);
  color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.carousel-btn{flex:0 0 36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,215,0,.4);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);color:#ffd700;font-size:1.4rem;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;
  line-height:1;padding:0;}
.carousel-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.15);border-color:#ffd700;}
/* ── CARROSSEL ABA DE CARTAS ── */
.ctk-section{margin-bottom:2rem;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;}
.ctk-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;margin-top:1rem;min-width:0;width:100%;max-width:100%;}
.ctk-track{display:flex;gap:.6rem;overflow-x:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth;padding:.6rem .2rem;flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:100%;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(255,215,0,.25) transparent;cursor:grab;}
.ctk-track::-webkit-scrollbar{height:3px;}
.ctk-track::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,215,0,.25);border-radius:2px;}
.ctk-btn{flex:0 0 32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,215,0,.35);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);color:#ffd700;font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s;line-height:1;padding:0;}
.ctk-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.12);border-color:#ffd700;}
.ctk-card{flex:0 0 150px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius:9px;padding:.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;position:relative;}
.ctk-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.05);border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.5);background:rgba(255,215,0,.06);}
.ctk-card img{width:130px;height:182px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;display:block;}
.ctk-badges{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;min-height:12px;}
.ctk-name{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);text-align:center;
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;width:100%;}
.ctk-num{font-size:.58rem;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-left:3px;}
.ctk-price{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:#ffd700;}
.feat-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2.5rem;}
.feat-head .label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-bottom:.6rem;display:block;}
.feat-head h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:400;color:var(--white);line-height:1.2;}
.feat-head h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--yellow);}

.feat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem;}
@media(max-width:1200px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
@media(max-width:700px){.feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.feat-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:border-color .2s;}
.feat-card:hover{border-color:rgba(245,197,24,.45);}
.feat-top{display:flex;gap:1.25rem;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 1.1rem;align-items:flex-start;}
.feat-img{
  flex-shrink:0;width:140px;height:196px;
  border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:3.5rem;position:relative;
  cursor:zoom-in;
}
.feat-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .2s;}
.feat-img:hover img{transform:scale(1.04);}
.feat-rarity{
  position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:.5rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);color:var(--yellow);
  padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px;
}
/* ── ZOOM MODAL ── */
.zoom-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:900;background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:zoom-out;}
.zoom-overlay.open{display:flex;}
.zoom-overlay img{max-width:min(420px,90vw);max-height:90vh;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.7);object-fit:contain;animation:zoomIn .2s ease;}
@keyframes zoomIn{from{transform:scale(.85);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.zoom-hint{position:absolute;bottom:6px;right:6px;font-size:.5rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;}
.feat-img:hover .zoom-hint{opacity:1;}
.feat-info{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.feat-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:.6rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);}
.feat-name{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--white);line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:.3rem;}
.feat-name small{display:block;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.feat-number{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.feat-desc{font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);line-height:1.6;}
.feat-bottom{padding:.875rem 1.5rem 1.25rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.875rem;margin-top:auto;}
.feat-price-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;}
.feat-price-lbl{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.feat-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.9rem;color:var(--yellow);line-height:1;}
.feat-wa{background:var(--yellow);color:#1a1a2e;border:none;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:800;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:background .15s,transform .15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.feat-wa:hover{background:#e6c000;transform:scale(1.04);}
.feat-wa svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:#1a1a2e;}
}
.col-section-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  padding:.875rem 1.25rem;border-radius:8px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  margin-bottom:.25rem;
  min-height:56px;
}
.col-section-name{
  font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}

/* ─── ABAS PRINCIPAIS ─── */
.tabs-bar{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding:.3rem 0;}
.main-tabs{display:flex;gap:.15rem;list-style:none;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;}
.main-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.main-tabs li{flex-shrink:0;}
.main-tabs li button{background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:4px;transition:background .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.main-tabs li button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--white);}
.main-tabs li button.active{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);}
.tab-section{display:none;}
.tab-section.active{display:block;}

/* ─── SOBRE ─── */
.about{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.6fr;gap:5rem;align-items:start;}
.about-left h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:400;line-height:1.2;margin-top:.75rem;}
.about-right p{font-size:var(--fs-md);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:1.2rem;}
.about-right p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.about-right strong{color:var(--black);font-weight:700;}

/* ─── DIFERENCIAIS ─── */
.feats-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--off);}
.feats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;}
.feat-item{background:var(--off);padding:2rem 1.75rem;}
.feat-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem;font-weight:700;}
.feat-item h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.feat-item p{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;}

/* ─── COLEÇÕES ─── */
.colecs-wrap{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.col-tabs{display:flex;gap:.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--off);padding:4px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:2rem;}
.col-tab{background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:4px;transition:background .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.col-tab.active{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);}
.col-tab:not(.active):hover{background:rgba(26,109,181,.1);color:var(--blue);}
.colecs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.col-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--white);}
.col-img{height:150px;position:relative;background:var(--off);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;}
.col-img img{max-width:85%;max-height:80%;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
.col-badge{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;color:var(--white);}
.col-badge.new-2026{background:var(--red);}
.col-badge.mega{background:var(--blue);}
.col-badge.sv{background:var(--muted);}
.col-body{padding:1.1rem 1.25rem;}
.col-body h3{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:3px;}
.col-meta{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.75rem;}
.col-body p{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:#555;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:.875rem;}
.col-link{font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;transition:gap .15s;}
.col-link:hover{gap:8px;}
.col-link::after{content:'→';}

/* ─── RARIDADES ─── */
.rarities-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--off);}
.rar-group-title{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin:0 0 1rem;}
.rar-cards-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.rar-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:12px;padding:1.2rem 1rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;text-align:center;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s;}
.rar-card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.35);background:rgba(255,215,0,.05);}
.rar-card-gold{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.2);}
.rar-card-silver{border-color:rgba(220,220,220,.2);}
.rar-card-hyper{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.35);background:rgba(255,215,0,.04);}
.rar-sym-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-height:48px;}
.rar-sym-text{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1;}
.rar-card-name{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);line-height:1.3;}
.rar-card-desc{font-size:.62rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);line-height:1.45;}
.rar-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.55rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,215,0,.18);color:var(--yellow);margin-left:3px;vertical-align:middle;}
.rar-tag-silver{background:rgba(200,200,200,.18);color:#ccc;}
.rar-tag-gold{background:rgba(255,215,0,.25);color:#ffd700;}

/* ─── CARTAS ─── */
.cards-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;}

/* toolbar de ordenação */
.cards-toolbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;
  margin-bottom:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
#card-search::placeholder{color:rgba(168,192,216,.6);}
#card-search:focus{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.5);}
.cards-toolbar-label{font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-right:.25rem;}
.sort-btn{
  background:var(--off);border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;
  padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
  letter-spacing:.04em;transition:background .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.sort-btn.active{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--blue);}
.sort-btn:not(.active):hover{background:rgba(26,109,181,.1);color:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);}

.rar-section{margin-bottom:3rem;}
.rar-section:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.rar-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:1.1rem;}
.rar-stripe{width:3px;height:20px;border-radius:2px;}
.rar-head h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;}
.rar-count{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;}
.pcards-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:.875rem;}
.pcard{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--white);}
.pcard.highlight{border:2px solid var(--yellow);}
.pcard-thumb{
  background:var(--off);height:160px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:2.4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow:hidden;position:relative;cursor:zoom-in;
  padding:6px;
}
.pcard-thumb img{
  width:auto;height:100%;max-width:100%;
  object-fit:contain;display:block;
  transition:transform .2s;
}
.pcard-thumb:hover img{transform:scale(1.04);}
.pcard-thumb-hint{
  position:absolute;bottom:4px;right:4px;
  font-size:.5rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);
  padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;pointer-events:none;
}
.pcard-thumb:hover .pcard-thumb-hint{opacity:1;}
.pcard-bar{height:2px;}
.pcard-body{padding:.8rem 1rem;}
.pcard-name{font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-sm);margin-bottom:2px;color:var(--black);}
.pcard-set{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.7rem;}
.pcard-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5rem;}
.pcard-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--yellow);}
.pcard.highlight .pcard-price{color:var(--yellow);}
.pcard-btn{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);border:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .15s;}
.pcard-btn:hover{background:var(--blue-dk);}

/* filtro de coleção na aba cartas */
.set-filter-bar{
  display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:4px 0;margin-bottom:1rem;
}
.set-filter-btn{
  background:var(--off);border:2px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:8px;padding:.4rem .5rem .35rem;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;
  transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;min-width:72px;max-width:90px;
}
.set-filter-btn img{width:64px;height:36px;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
.set-filter-btn span{font-size:.52rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--muted);text-align:center;line-height:1.2;white-space:normal;}
.set-filter-btn.active{border-color:var(--yellow);background:rgba(255,215,0,.08);}
.set-filter-btn.active span{color:var(--yellow);}
.set-filter-btn:not(.active):hover{border-color:var(--blue);background:rgba(26,109,181,.1);}
.set-filter-btn:not(.active):hover span{color:var(--white);}

/* ─── PRODUTOS ─── */
.prods-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.prods-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.prod-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--white);}
.prod-thumb{background:var(--off);height:160px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;}
.prod-badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;}
.prod-body{padding:1.1rem 1.25rem;}
.prod-body h3{font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:3px;}
.prod-meta{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.prod-body p{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:#555;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:.875rem;}
.prod-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.prod-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--blue);}
.prod-btn{background:var(--blue);color:var(--white);border:none;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;}
.prod-btn:hover{background:var(--blue-dk);}
.btn-esgotado{background:#4a4a4a;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);border:none;font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:4px;cursor:not-allowed;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.acc-esgotado{display:inline-block;background:#4a4a4a;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:.6rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.4rem;}

/* ─── SUB-ABAS FIGURINHAS ─── */
.fig-subtab-nav{display:flex;gap:.35rem;margin-bottom:2rem;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);padding-bottom:0;}
.fig-subtab{background:transparent;border:none;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:700;padding:.6rem 1.4rem;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s,border-color .15s;font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-bottom:-2px;}
.fig-subtab.active{color:var(--yellow);border-bottom-color:var(--yellow);}
.fig-subtab:hover:not(.active){color:var(--white);}
/* grid avulsas */
.fig-avulsas-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem;}
.fig-avulsas-header p{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);}
.fig-avulsas-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.5rem;}
.fig-grupo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;}
.fig-grupo-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:.7rem 1rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
.fig-grupo-flag{font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1;}
.fig-grupo-nome{font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--white);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.fig-grupo-qtd{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;}
.fig-av-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:.85rem;padding:1rem;}
.fig-av-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:10px;padding:.6rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;text-align:center;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.fig-av-card:hover{border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.5);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
/* imagem estilo Panini */
.fig-av-img{width:96px;height:130px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);position:relative;flex-shrink:0;}
.fig-av-img-top{font-size:.52rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:3px 0;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.fig-av-img-ico{font-size:2.6rem;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;}
.fig-av-img-num{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.6rem;color:#fff;font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.6);line-height:1;padding:0 0 2px;}
.fig-av-img-bot{font-size:.42rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.18em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);padding:3px 0;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0;}
.fig-av-desc{font-size:.6rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);line-height:1.4;max-width:130px;}
.fig-av-num{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:-.1rem;}
.fig-av-price{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--yellow);}
.fig-av-btn{background:rgba(255,215,0,.1);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,215,0,.28);color:var(--yellow);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;padding:6px 0;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s;font-family:inherit;width:100%;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.fig-av-btn:hover{background:var(--yellow);color:#1a1a2e;}.fig-av-photo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;background:#111;}
.fig-av-img.has-photo{cursor:zoom-in;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s;}
.fig-av-img.has-photo:hover{transform:scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.7);}
/* ── LIGHTBOX ── */
#fig-lightbox{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:1rem;animation:lbIn .18s ease;}
#fig-lightbox.open{display:flex;}
@keyframes lbIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
#fig-lightbox .lb-inner{position:relative;max-width:min(480px,94vw);width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;}
#fig-lightbox .lb-img{width:100%;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.8);display:block;object-fit:contain;}
#fig-lightbox .lb-info{color:#fff;text-align:center;font-size:.85rem;opacity:.85;line-height:1.5;}
#fig-lightbox .lb-close{position:absolute;top:-2.2rem;right:0;background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:1.8rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;opacity:.75;transition:opacity .15s;}
#fig-lightbox .lb-close:hover{opacity:1;}
#fig-lightbox .lb-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;cursor:zoom-out;}
@media(max-width:480px){.fig-av-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(115px,1fr));}.fig-av-img{width:80px;height:108px;}}

/* ─── PROMO FIGURINHAS COPA (home) ─── */
.copa-promo{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#012d14 0%,#01491f 45%,#00347a 100%);border-top:3px solid #ffd700;border-bottom:3px solid #ffd700;padding:2rem 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.copa-promo::before{content:'⚽';position:absolute;right:-10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:14rem;opacity:.06;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;}
.copa-promo-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.copa-promo-img{flex-shrink:0;width:110px;height:140px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55);background:#fff;}
.copa-promo-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
.copa-promo-info{flex:1;min-width:200px;}
.copa-promo-badge{display:inline-block;background:#ffd700;color:#0a2200;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:900;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.copa-promo-title{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:.2rem;}
.copa-promo-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);margin-bottom:.8rem;}
.copa-promo-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:2rem;color:#ffd700;line-height:1;}
.copa-promo-priceper{font-size:.72rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-left:.3rem;vertical-align:middle;}
.copa-promo-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;margin-top:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.copa-promo-qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;}
.copa-promo-qty button{width:32px;height:32px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:6px;color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.copa-promo-qty button:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.25);border-color:#ffd700;}
.copa-promo-qty span{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;min-width:28px;text-align:center;}
.copa-promo-total{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1rem;color:#ffd700;}
.copa-promo-btn{background:#ffd700;color:#0a2200;border:none;border-radius:7px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:800;padding:11px 24px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,transform .1s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.copa-promo-btn:hover{background:#e6c000;transform:translateY(-1px);}
.copa-promo-detail{font-size:.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);margin-top:.6rem;line-height:1.6;}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .copa-promo-inner{gap:1.25rem;}
  .copa-promo-img{width:80px;height:102px;}
  .copa-promo-title{font-size:1.2rem;}
  .copa-promo-price{font-size:1.6rem;}
}

/* ─── ACESSÓRIOS ─── */
.acc-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.acc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.acc-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--white);}
.acc-thumb{background:var(--off);height:110px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.6rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.acc-body{padding:.875rem 1rem;}
.acc-body h3{font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-sm);margin-bottom:2px;}
.acc-desc{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.625rem;line-height:1.5;}
.acc-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--blue);}

/* ─── FIGURINHAS COPA ─── */
.figurinhas-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;}
.fig-product-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
.fig-product-card{display:flex;gap:3rem;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:2.5rem;max-width:860px;width:100%;}
.fig-img-col{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1rem;}
.fig-pack-visual{width:220px;height:280px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.1);position:relative;background:#fff;}
.fig-pack-visual svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;}
.fig-info-col{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.fig-badge{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#006622,#004499);color:#ffd700;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1.1rem;}
.fig-name{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.85rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--white);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.fig-sub{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.4rem;}
.fig-detail{font-size:.78rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);margin-bottom:1.6rem;line-height:1.6;}
.fig-price-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.fig-price{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--yellow);}
.fig-price-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);}
.fig-qty-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.fig-qty-lbl{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;}
.fig-qty-ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;}
.fig-qty-ctrl button{width:34px;height:34px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:7px;color:var(--white);font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1;}
.fig-qty-ctrl button:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.2);border-color:var(--yellow);}
.fig-qty-ctrl span{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);min-width:36px;text-align:center;}
.fig-qty-total{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--yellow);}
.fig-add-btn{background:var(--yellow);color:#1a1a2e;border:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;padding:14px 32px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,transform .1s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:1rem;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.fig-add-btn:hover{background:#e6c000;transform:translateY(-1px);}
.fig-note{font-size:.75rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);line-height:1.7;}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .fig-product-card{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:1.5rem;gap:1.75rem;}
  .fig-pack-visual{width:180px;height:230px;}
  .fig-name{font-size:1.5rem;}
  .fig-price{font-size:2rem;}
}

/* ─── LOCALIZAÇÃO ─── */
.loc-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.loc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:4rem;align-items:start;}
.loc-info h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:var(--fs-lg);font-weight:400;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:1.5rem;margin-top:.5rem;}
.loc-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;margin-bottom:1.1rem;}
.loc-lbl{font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);}
.loc-val{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:var(--black);line-height:1.5;}
.loc-val a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}
.loc-btns{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.5rem;}
.map-box{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;height:340px;}
.map-box iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:none;display:block;}

/* ─── DEPOIMENTOS ─── */
.testi-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--off);}
.testi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.testi{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1.75rem;}
.testi-stars{color:var(--yellow);font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.testi-text{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:1.25rem;}
.testi-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.testi-av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue-lt);color:var(--blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;}
.testi-name{font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:700;}
.testi-sub{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);}

/* ─── FAQ ─── */
.faq-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.faq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--border);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;}
.faq-item{background:var(--bg-card);padding:1.75rem;}
.faq-item h4{font-size:var(--fs-sm);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.5rem;line-height:1.4;}
.faq-item p{font-size:var(--fs-sm);color:var(--muted);line-height:1.65;}

/* ─── CTA ─── */
.cta-sec{padding:var(--sec) 0;background:var(--blue);text-align:center;}
.cta-sec .label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-bottom:1.25rem;}
.cta-sec h2{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:400;color:var(--white);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:1rem;max-width:600px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
.cta-sec p{font-size:var(--fs-md);color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:2rem;max-width:440px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

/* ─── CALCULADORA DE FRETE ─── */
.frete-sec{padding:3rem 0;}
.frete-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;padding:1.75rem;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;}
.frete-form{display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.frete-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;flex:1 1 220px;}
.frete-field label{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
.frete-input-wrap{display:flex;gap:.5rem;}
.frete-input-wrap input{flex:1;padding:9px 12px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:6px;background:#0e2a4a;color:#fff;font-size:.95rem;font-family:inherit;outline:none;letter-spacing:.06em;}
.frete-input-wrap input:focus{border-color:var(--yellow);}
.frete-btn{background:var(--yellow);color:#1a1a2e;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;padding:9px 16px;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s;}
.frete-btn:hover{background:#e6c000;}
.frete-cep-link{font-size:.65rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);text-decoration:none;margin-top:-2px;}
.frete-cep-link:hover{color:var(--yellow);}
.frete-qty-opts{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.frete-qty-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
.frete-qty-btn.active{background:var(--yellow);color:#1a1a2e;border-color:var(--yellow);}
.frete-qty-btn:hover:not(.active){background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
.frete-result{margin-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding-top:1.25rem;}
.frete-loading{text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:.85rem;}
.frete-error{text-align:center;padding:1rem;color:#f87171;font-size:.82rem;background:rgba(248,113,113,.08);border-radius:8px;}
.frete-dest{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:8px;padding:.7rem .9rem;}
.frete-pin{font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1;}
.frete-dest strong{display:block;font-size:.88rem;color:#fff;font-weight:700;}
.frete-dest small{font-size:.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
.frete-options{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.65rem;}
.frete-opt{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:.85rem 1.1rem;gap:1rem;transition:border-color .15s;}
.frete-opt.pac:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);}
.frete-opt.sedex{border-color:rgba(255,200,50,.2);background:rgba(255,200,50,.04);}
.frete-opt.sedex:hover{border-color:rgba(255,200,50,.4);}
.frete-opt-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;}
.frete-opt-logo{font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1;}
.frete-opt-name{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;}
.frete-opt-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.55rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;margin-left:4px;vertical-align:middle;}
.frete-opt.sedex .frete-opt-tag{background:rgba(255,200,50,.15);color:rgba(255,200,50,.8);}
.frete-opt-desc{font-size:.65rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-top:1px;}
.frete-opt-right{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0;}
.frete-opt-price{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--yellow);}
.frete-opt-days{font-size:.63rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-top:2px;}
.frete-note{font-size:.6rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);margin-top:.85rem;line-height:1.55;text-align:center;}
.frete-correios-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.4rem;margin-top:1rem;opacity:.35;}
.frete-correios-logo span{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);}

/* ─── FOOTER ─── */
footer{border-top:2px solid var(--yellow);background:var(--blue-dk);padding:2rem 0;}
.footer-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;}
.footer-logo{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--white);}
.footer-logo span{color:var(--yellow);}
.footer-logo small{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);display:block;margin-top:-2px;}
.footer-note{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);}
.footer-links{display:flex;gap:1.5rem;list-style:none;}
.footer-links a{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);transition:color .15s;}
.footer-links a:hover{color:var(--yellow);}

/* ─── WA FLOAT ─── */
.wa-float{position:fixed;bottom:26px;right:26px;z-index:999;background:var(--wa);color:var(--white);width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(37,211,102,.4);transition:background .15s,transform .15s;}
.wa-float:hover{background:var(--wa-dk);transform:scale(1.08);}
.wa-float svg{width:30px;height:30px;fill:var(--white);}

/* ─── RESPONSIVE ─── */

/* impede scroll horizontal em qualquer tela */
html{overflow-x:hidden;}
body{overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100%;}
/* todas as sections contêm overflow horizontal */
section,nav,footer,.container{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;}

@media(max-width:960px){
  .hero-grid,.about-grid,.loc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem;}
  .hero-visual,.about-left{display:none;}
  .feat-grid,.colecs-grid,.prods-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .acc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pcards-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .testi-grid,.faq-grid,.feats-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .footer-inner{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;}
  .nav-links{display:none;}
  .rar-cards-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .hero-banner{height:200px;}
}

@media(max-width:600px){
  .feat-grid,.colecs-grid,.prods-grid,.acc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .feat-top{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;}
  .pcards-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .feat-img{width:120px;height:168px;}
  .rar-cards-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.75rem;}
}

/* ─── MOBILE PEQUENO (≤480 px) ─── */
@media(max-width:480px){
  /* nav: logo menor + oculta texto do WhatsApp */
  .nav-logo svg{height:44px !important;width:auto !important;max-width:180px;}
  .nav-wa-text{display:none;}
  .nav-wa{padding:8px 10px;}
  .container{padding:0 1rem;}

  /* hero */
  .hero-content-row{padding:2rem 0 2.5rem;}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,7vw,2.4rem);}
  .hero-banner{height:160px;}

  /* cartas destaque */
  .feat-top{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;}
  .feat-img{width:110px;height:154px;}
  .feat-price{font-size:1.4rem;}

  /* carrossel */
  .ctk-card{flex:0 0 120px;}
  .ctk-card img{width:104px;height:146px;}
  .carousel-card{flex:0 0 90px;}
  .carousel-card img{width:76px;height:106px;}

  /* toolbar de cartas */
  .cards-toolbar{gap:.35rem;}
  .sort-btn{padding:5px 8px;font-size:.65rem;}
  .set-filter-btn{padding:5px 8px;font-size:.65rem;}

  /* raridade */
  .rar-cards-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:.6rem;}
  .rar-card{padding:.9rem .7rem .8rem;}

  /* tabs */
  .main-tabs li button{padding:8px 12px;font-size:.75rem;}

  /* coleções grid */
  .colecs-grid,.prods-grid,.acc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}

  /* footer */
  .footer-links{flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;}
}

/* ═══════════════ CARRINHO ═══════════════ */
/* Botão flutuante */
.cart-fab{position:fixed;top:1rem;right:1rem;z-index:800;
  background:var(--yellow);color:var(--white);border:none;border-radius:50px;
  width:58px;height:58px;font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .2s,background .2s;}
.cart-fab:hover{transform:scale(1.08);background:#e6c300;}
.cart-badge{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;background:#cc2200;color:#fff;
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:900;min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px;
  border:2px solid var(--bg-page);}

/* Overlay escuro */
.cart-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:810;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
.cart-overlay.open{display:block;}

/* Painel lateral */
.cart-panel{position:fixed;top:0;right:-400px;width:min(400px,100vw);height:100dvh;
  z-index:820;background:#0e2a4a;border-left:2px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:right .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  box-shadow:-8px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
.cart-panel.open{right:0;}

.cart-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:1rem 1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-header h3{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--yellow);}
.cart-close{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  font-size:1.4rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;}
.cart-close:hover{color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}

/* Lista de itens */
.cart-items{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:.75rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;}
.cart-empty{text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);font-size:.85rem;margin-top:3rem;line-height:1.8;}
.cart-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:8px;padding:.6rem;}
.cart-item img{width:44px;height:62px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:5px;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.cart-item-info{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.cart-item-name{display:block;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);
  white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.cart-item-price{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--yellow);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px;}
.cart-item-qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-item-qty button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  color:var(--white);width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
  font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.cart-item-qty button:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.2);border-color:var(--yellow);}
.cart-item-qty span{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);min-width:18px;text-align:center;}
.cart-item-remove{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-item-remove:hover{color:#cc2200;background:rgba(204,34,0,.1);}

/* Rodapé do carrinho */
.cart-footer{padding:1rem 1.2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-total-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.cart-total-lbl{font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;}
.cart-total-val{font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--yellow);}
.cart-send-btn{width:100%;background:var(--wa);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:7px;
  padding:.85rem;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;transition:background .2s;}
.cart-send-btn:hover{background:var(--wa-dk);}
.cart-send-btn:disabled{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);cursor:not-allowed;}

/* Botão adicionar no card */
.ctk-add-btn{width:100%;margin-top:.25rem;background:rgba(255,215,0,.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.25);border-radius:5px;color:var(--yellow);
  font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;padding:4px 0;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.ctk-add-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,215,0,.28);border-color:var(--yellow);}

/* Toast de confirmação */
.cart-toast{position:fixed;top:5rem;right:1rem;z-index:830;
  background:#1a4a2e;border:1px solid var(--wa);color:#fff;
  font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;padding:.55rem 1rem;border-radius:7px;
  transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;white-space:nowrap;}
.cart-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ═══ JS ═══ -->
<script>
/* ── ZOOM MODAL ── */
function openZoom(src) {
  const ov = document.getElementById('zoom-overlay');
  const img = document.getElementById('zoom-img');
  if (!ov || !img) return;
  img.src = src;
  ov.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeZoom() {
  const ov = document.getElementById('zoom-overlay');
  if (ov) ov.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key==='Escape') closeZoom(); });

function taurosImgFallback() {
  const img = document.getElementById('tauros-img');
  const fb  = document.getElementById('tauros-fallback');
  if (img) img.style.display = 'none';
  if (fb)  fb.style.display  = 'flex';
}

/* ── FALLBACK DRI (Destined Rivals / folder 412) — varre ±150 IDs ── */
function driFallback(img) {
  if (!img._driTry) img._driTry = 0;
  img._driTry++;
  const src = img.src;
  const m = src.match(/den-cards\.pokellector\.com\/412\/(.+\.DRI\.\d+\.)(\d+)(\.png)$/);
  if (!m) { img.style.display='none'; if(img.nextElementSibling) img.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex'; return; }
  const prefix=m[1], baseId=parseInt(m[2]), suffix=m[3];
  const step=Math.ceil(img._driTry/2), offset=img._driTry%2===1?step:-step;
  if (step<=10) { img.src=`https://den-cards.pokellector.com/412/${prefix}${baseId+offset}${suffix}`; }
  else { img.style.display='none'; const fb=img.nextElementSibling; if(fb&&fb.tagName!=='SPAN') fb.style.display='flex'; }
}
/* ── MEP Tyrunt #70 — scan proativo de IDs via Image() ── */
function scanTyruntId() {
  // Tenta carregar cada ID em sequência até encontrar um válido
  const startId = 59700;
  const endId   = 63000;
  let current   = startId;

  function tryNext() {
    if (current > endId) return; // desistiu
    const url = `https://den-cards.pokellector.com/423/Tyrunt.MEP.70.${current}.png`;
    const tester = new Image();
    tester.onload = function() {
      // Achou! Atualiza todos os elementos com data-cardid="124"
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-cardid="124"]').forEach(el => {
        el.src = url;
        el.style.display = 'block';
        const fb = el.nextElementSibling;
        if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'none';
        const wrap = el.closest('.pcard-thumb');
        if (wrap) { wrap.style.cursor = 'zoom-in'; wrap.onclick = () => openZoom(url); }
      });
    };
    tester.onerror = function() { current++; tryNext(); };
    tester.src = url;
  }
  tryNext();
}

function mepFallback(img) {
  // Inicia o scan proativo quando a imagem estimada falha
  if (!img._mepStarted) {
    img._mepStarted = true;
    scanTyruntId();
  }
  // Mostra emoji enquanto busca
  img.style.display = 'none';
  const fb = img.nextElementSibling;
  if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'flex';
}

/* ── FALLBACK CARTAS PRE (Prismatic Evolutions) — varre ±150 IDs ── */
function preFallback(img) {
  if (!img._preTry) img._preTry = 0;
  img._preTry++;
  const src = img.src;
  const m = src.match(/den-cards\.pokellector\.com\/407\/(.+\.PRE\.\d+\.)(\d+)(\.png)$/);
  if (!m) { img.style.display='none'; if(img.nextElementSibling) img.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex'; return; }
  const prefix = m[1], baseId = parseInt(m[2]), suffix = m[3];
  const step = Math.ceil(img._preTry / 2);
  const offset = img._preTry % 2 === 1 ? step : -step;
  if (step <= 10) {
    img.src = `https://den-cards.pokellector.com/407/${prefix}${baseId + offset}${suffix}`;
  } else {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    const fb = img.nextElementSibling;
    if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'flex';
  }
}

/* ── FALLBACK CARTAS COMUNS POR ── */
function porFallback(img) {
  if (!img._porTry) img._porTry = 0;
  img._porTry++;
  const src = img.src;
  const m = src.match(/den-cards\.pokellector\.com\/429\/(.+\.POR\.\d+\.)(\d+)(\.png)$/);
  if (!m) { img.style.display='none'; if(img.nextElementSibling) img.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex'; return; }
  const prefix = m[1], baseId = parseInt(m[2]), suffix = m[3];
  const step = Math.ceil(img._porTry / 2);
  const offset = img._porTry % 2 === 1 ? step : -step;
  if (step <= 10) {
    img.src = `https://den-cards.pokellector.com/429/${prefix}${baseId + offset}${suffix}`;
  } else {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    const fb = img.nextElementSibling;
    if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'flex';
  }
}

/* ── FALLBACK CARTAS COMUNS ASC — varre ±150 IDs no den-cards.pokellector.com ── */
function ascFallback(img) {
  if (!img._ascTry) img._ascTry = 0;
  img._ascTry++;
  const src = img.src;
  const m = src.match(/den-cards\.pokellector\.com\/426\/(.+\.ASC\.\d+\.)(\d+)(\.png)$/);
  if (!m) { img.style.display='none'; if(img.nextElementSibling) img.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex'; return; }
  const prefix = m[1], baseId = parseInt(m[2]), suffix = m[3];
  // Varre: +1,-1,+2,-2,...,+150,-150
  const step = Math.ceil(img._ascTry / 2);
  const offset = img._ascTry % 2 === 1 ? step : -step;
  if (step <= 10) {
    img.src = `https://den-cards.pokellector.com/426/${prefix}${baseId + offset}${suffix}`;
  } else {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    const fb = img.nextElementSibling;
    if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'flex';
  }
}

}

/* ── FALLBACK CARROSSEL ── */
function ctkFallback(img) {
  const isCtk = !!img.closest('.ctk-card');
  const w = isCtk ? 130 : 90;
  const h = isCtk ? 182 : 126;
  const name = (img.closest('[data-cname]') || img).dataset.cname || '';
  img.style.display = 'none';
  const fb = document.createElement('div');
  fb.style.cssText = `width:${w}px;height:${h}px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a0a2e,#0d1b3e);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);flex-shrink:0;`;
  fb.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:1.8rem;">⚫</span>' +
    (name ? '<span style="font-size:.5rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-align:center;padding:0 6px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;">' + name + '</span>' : '');
  img.parentNode.insertBefore(fb, img);
}

/* ── CARROSSEL ── */
function buildCarousel() {
  const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
  if (!track || !CARDS_DATA) return;
  const sorted = [...CARDS_DATA].sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);
  track.innerHTML = sorted.map(c => {
    const promo = c.promo ? `<span class="cc-promo">⭐ PROMO</span>` : '';
    const _det = (c.detail||'').toLowerCase(); const _pb = _det.includes('pokebola')||_det.includes('pokébola'); const pokeball = _pb ? `<span class="cc-promo" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e61010,#ff6b6b);">🔴 PB</span>` : ''; const foil = !_pb && _det.includes('foil') ? `<span class="cc-promo" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9a000,#f5e67a,#c9a000);color:#3a2000;">✨ FOIL</span>` : ''; const reverse = !_pb && !foil && _det.includes('reverse') ? `<span class="cc-promo" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9,#6366f1);">✦ REV</span>` : '';
    const price = c.price > 0 ? `<span class="cc-price">R$ ${c.price.toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}</span>` : '';
    const nmMatch = (c.detail || '').match(/^(\d+\/\d+)/);
    const numTag = nmMatch ? `<span class="cc-num">${nmMatch[1]}</span>` : '';
    return `<div class="carousel-card" data-cname="${c.name}" onclick="openZoom('${c.img}')" title="${c.name}">
      <img src="${c.img}" alt="${c.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="ctkFallback(this)">
      ${promo}${pokeball}${foil}${reverse}
      <span class="cc-name">${c.name}${numTag}</span>
      ${price}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  /* drag-to-scroll */
  let isDown = false, startX, scrollLeft;
  track.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { isDown=true; track.classList.add('active'); startX=e.pageX-track.offsetLeft; scrollLeft=track.scrollLeft; });
  track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown=false; });
  track.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDown=false; });
  track.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if(!isDown) return; e.preventDefault(); const x=e.pageX-track.offsetLeft; track.scrollLeft=scrollLeft-(x-startX)*1.5; });
}
function carouselScroll(dir) {
  const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track');
  if (track) track.scrollBy({ left: dir * 440, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', buildCarousel);

function dragalgeImgFallback() {
  const img2 = document.getElementById('dragalge-img2');
  if (!img2 || !img2.src || img2.src === location.href) return;
  const fb = document.getElementById('dragalge-fallback');
  if (img2) img2.style.display = 'none';
  if (fb)   fb.style.display   = 'flex';
}

  const logo  = SET_LOGOS[col];

    ? `<img src="${logo}" alt="${col}" style="height:36px;max-width:140px;object-fit:contain;" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
    : '';
  return `<div class="col-section-head" style="background:${color};">

    <span class="col-section-name">${col}</span>

}
