const RARITY_LABELS = { hr:'Rara Hiper (Gold)', sr:'Ilustração Rara Especial', ur:'Rara Ultra (Full Art)', ir:'Ilustração Rara', rr:'Raras Duplas', r:'Raro', u:'Incomum', c:'Comum', cu:'Comum / Incomum' };
const RARITY_ORDER  = ['hr','sr','ur','ir','rr','r','cu'];
function rarityFilter(data, r){ return r==='cu' ? data.filter(c=>c.rarity==='c'||c.rarity==='u') : data.filter(c=>c.rarity===r); }

function getCardNum(c){
  const m = (c.detail || '').match(/^(\d+)/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 9999;
}

/* ordem de exibição dos sets */
const SET_ORDER = ['Heróis Excelsos','Caos Ascendente','Equilíbrio Perfeito','Fogo Branco','Rivais Predestinados','Fogo Fantasmagórico','Mega Evolution','Prismatic Evolutions'];

let currentViewMode = 'carrossel';
let currentSort     = 'default';
let currentSet      = 'todas';

function fmtPrice(p){ return 'R$ ' + p.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); }

/* ── CACHE DE IMAGENS API ── */
const IMG_CACHE = {};

async function loadApiCardImages() {
  const cards = CARDS_DATA.filter(c => c.apiCard && !IMG_CACHE[c.apiCard]);
  if (!cards.length) return;

  // Tenta por ID direto primeiro (ex: asc-8), depois por set+number
  const setId = 'asc';
  const numbers = cards.map(c => c.apiCard.replace(`${setId}-`, ''));
  const q = `set.id:${setId} (${numbers.map(n => `number:${n}`).join(' OR ')})`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      `https://api.pokemontcg.io/v2/cards?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&pageSize=250&select=id,number,images`
    );
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.status);
    const data = await res.json();

    (data.data || []).forEach(card => {
      const img = card.images?.large || card.images?.small;
      const key = `${setId}-${card.number}`;
      if (img) IMG_CACHE[key] = img;
    });

    // Se a API não tem o set ainda, tenta via nome
    const missing = cards.filter(c => !IMG_CACHE[c.apiCard]);
    if (missing.length && (data.data || []).length === 0) {
      // Set não indexado — tenta buscar as cartas pelos sets JP de origem
      await loadFromJPSets(missing);
      return;
    }

    refreshCardImages(cards);
  } catch(e) {
    // API indisponível — tenta sets JP de origem
    await loadFromJPSets(cards);
  }
}

// Mapeamento para sets JP de origem das cartas comuns do ASC
const JP_ORIGINS = {
  'asc-2':  { set:'sd100', num:'2'  },  // Erika's Gloom — Start Deck 100
  'asc-8':  { set:'sd100', num:'8'  },  // Chikorita
  'asc-14': { set:'mex',   num:'7'  },  // Cascoon — MEGA Dream ex
  'asc-17': { set:'mex',   num:'16' },  // Grubbin — MEGA Dream ex (aprox)
  'asc-20': { set:'sd100', num:'20' },  // Charmander
  'asc-30': { set:'mex',   num:'25' },  // Pignite
  'asc-39': { set:'mex',   num:'32' },  // Psyduck
  'asc-41': { set:'sd100', num:'41' },  // Totodile
  'asc-42': { set:'sd100', num:'42' },  // Croconaw
  'asc-46': { set:'mex',   num:'35' },  // Snorunt
  'asc-51': { set:'mex',   num:'39' },  // N's Vanilluxe
  'asc-52': { set:'mex',   num:'40' },  // Snom
  'asc-83': { set:'sd100', num:'83' },  // Marill
  'asc-87': { set:'sd100', num:'87' },  // Ralts (aprox)
  'asc-88': { set:'sd100', num:'88' },  // Kirlia
  'asc-92': { set:'sd100', num:'92' },  // Rotom
  'asc-95': { set:'sd100', num:'95' },  // Hop's Phantump
};

async function loadFromJPSets(cards) {
  const bySet = {};
  cards.forEach(c => {
    const origin = JP_ORIGINS[c.apiCard];
    if (!origin) return;
    (bySet[origin.set] = bySet[origin.set] || []).push({ card: c, num: origin.num });
  });
  for (const [setId, items] of Object.entries(bySet)) {
    const q = `set.id:${setId} (${items.map(i => `number:${i.num}`).join(' OR ')})`;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`https://api.pokemontcg.io/v2/cards?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&pageSize=100&select=id,number,images`);
      if (!res.ok) continue;
      const data = await res.json();
      const byNum = {};
      (data.data || []).forEach(card => { byNum[card.number] = card.images?.large || card.images?.small; });
      items.forEach(({ card, num }) => {
        if (byNum[num]) IMG_CACHE[card.apiCard] = byNum[num];
      });
    } catch(e) { /* silent */ }
  }
  refreshCardImages(cards);
}

function refreshCardImages(cards) {
  cards.forEach(c => {
    const url = IMG_CACHE[c.apiCard];
    if (!url) return;
    // Atualiza todos os elementos com data-cardid
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-cardid="${c.id}"]`).forEach(imgEl => {
      imgEl.src = url;
      imgEl.style.display = 'block';
      const fb = imgEl.nextElementSibling;
      if (fb && fb.tagName !== 'SPAN') fb.style.display = 'none';
      const wrap = imgEl.closest('.pcard-thumb');
      if (wrap) {
        wrap.style.cursor = 'zoom-in';
        wrap.onclick = () => openZoom(url);
      }
    });
  });
}

function buildCardHTML(c){
  const color   = RARITY_COLORS[c.rarity] || '#4a6a7a';
  const hl      = c.highlight ? ' highlight' : '';
  const stockBadge = (c.stock && c.stock > 1)
    ? `<span style="position:absolute;top:4px;right:4px;background:var(--blue);color:white;font-size:.5rem;font-weight:800;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.05em;">${c.stock}×</span>`
    : '';
  const _bd = (c.detail||'').toLowerCase(); const _bpb = _bd.includes('pokebola')||_bd.includes('pokébola');
  const foilBadge = _bpb
    ? `<span style="position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e61010,#ff6b6b);color:#fff;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);">🔴 POKÉBOLA</span>`
    : _bd.includes('foil')
    ? `<span style="position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9a000,#f5e67a,#c9a000);color:#3a2000;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);">✨ FOIL</span>`
    : _bd.includes('reverse')
    ? `<span style="position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9,#6366f1);color:#fff;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);">✦ REVERSE</span>`
    : '';
  const promoBadge = c.promo
    ? `<span style="position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b44cff,#7c3aed);color:#fff;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5);">⭐ PROMO</span>`
    : '';

  let thumb;
  if (c.apiCard) {
    // Carta com imagem via API — mostra emoji enquanto carrega
    const cached = IMG_CACHE[c.apiCard];
    const imgSrc = cached || '';
    const imgStyle = cached ? 'display:block' : 'display:none';
    const fbStyle  = cached ? 'display:none'  : 'display:flex';
    const zoomClick = cached ? `onclick="openZoom('${cached}')"` : '';
    thumb = `<div class="pcard-thumb" style="position:relative;cursor:${cached?'zoom-in':'default'};" ${zoomClick}>
        <img data-cardid="${c.id}" src="${imgSrc}" alt="${c.name}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;${imgStyle}">
        <div style="${fbStyle};width:100%;height:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2rem;background:var(--off);color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);">${c.emoji||'?'}</div>
        <span class="pcard-thumb-hint">🔍 Ampliar</span>
        ${stockBadge}${foilBadge}${promoBadge}
      </div>`;
  } else if (c.img) {
    const onerrorAttr = c.id === 26
      ? `onerror="bulbasaurFallback(this)"`
      : (c.id >= 50 && c.id <= 85)
        ? `onerror="ascFallback(this)"`
        : (c.id >= 90 && c.id <= 96)
          ? `onerror="porFallback(this)"`
          : (c.id >= 100 && c.id <= 114)
            ? `onerror="preFallback(this)"`
            : (c.id >= 120 && c.id <= 123)
              ? `onerror="driFallback(this)"`
              : `onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex'"`;
    const isBase64 = c.img.startsWith('data:');
    const thumbClick = isBase64
      ? `onclick="openZoom(this.querySelector('img').src)"`
      : `onclick="openZoom('${c.img}')"`;
    thumb = `<div class="pcard-thumb" ${thumbClick} style="position:relative;cursor:zoom-in;">
        <img data-cardid="${c.id}" src="${c.img}" alt="${c.name}" ${onerrorAttr}>
        <div style="display:none;width:100%;height:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2rem;background:var(--off);color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);">${c.emoji||'?'}</div>
        <span class="pcard-thumb-hint">🔍 Ampliar</span>
        ${stockBadge}${foilBadge}${promoBadge}
       </div>`;
  } else {
    thumb = `<div class="pcard-thumb" style="position:relative;cursor:default;font-size:2rem;">${c.emoji||'?'}${stockBadge}${foilBadge}${promoBadge}</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="pcard${hl}" data-id="${c.id}">
    ${thumb}
    <div class="pcard-bar" style="background:${color}"></div>
    <div class="pcard-body">
      <div class="pcard-name">${c.name}</div>
      <div class="pcard-set">${c.detail}</div>
      <div class="pcard-foot">
        <span class="pcard-price">${fmtPrice(c.price)}</span>
        <button class="pcard-btn" onclick="window.open('https://wa.me/5517992709588?text=Interesse+${encodeURIComponent(c.name)}','_blank')">+</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function getFiltered(){
  const q = (document.getElementById('card-search')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let data = [...CARDS_DATA];
  if(currentSet !== 'todas') data = data.filter(c => c.collection === currentSet);
  if(q) data = data.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.collection.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.detail.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  if(currentSort === 'az')   data.sort((a,b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'pt-BR'));
  else if(currentSort === 'za')   data.sort((a,b) => b.name.localeCompare(a.name,'pt-BR'));
  else if(currentSort === 'asc')  data.sort((a,b) => a.price - b.price);
  else if(currentSort === 'desc') data.sort((a,b) => b.price - a.price);
  return data;
}

function raritySubgroups(data, sectionStyle){
  let html = '';
  RARITY_ORDER.forEach(r => {
    const group = rarityFilter(data, r);
    if(!group.length) return;
    html += `<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:.75rem;padding-bottom:.4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">
        <div style="width:3px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;background:${RARITY_COLORS[r]};flex-shrink:0"></div>
        <span style="font-size:var(--fs-xs);font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">${RARITY_LABELS[r]}</span>
        <span style="font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;">${group.length} carta${group.length!==1?'s':''}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pcards-grid">${group.map(buildCardHTML).join('')}</div>
    </div>`;
  });
  return html;
}

function renderCards(data){
  const container = document.getElementById('cards-container');
  if(!container) return;

  if(!data || !data.length){
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem;color:var(--muted)"><p>Nenhuma carta encontrada.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  /* ── MODO COLEÇÃO (padrão) ── */
  if(currentViewMode === 'colecao'){
    /* grupos de coleção respeitando a ordem SET_ORDER */
    const byCol = {};
    data.forEach(c => { (byCol[c.collection] = byCol[c.collection]||[]).push(c); });
    const orderedCols = [...SET_ORDER.filter(s => byCol[s]), ...Object.keys(byCol).filter(s => !SET_ORDER.includes(s))];

    let html = '';
    orderedCols.forEach(col => {
      const group = byCol[col];
      html += `<div class="col-section" style="margin-bottom:2.5rem;">
        ${setColHeaderHTML(col)}
        <div style="margin-top:1.25rem;">
          ${raritySubgroups(group, col)}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
    return;
  }

  /* ── MODO RARIDADE ── */
  if(currentViewMode === 'raridade'){
    let html = '';
    RARITY_ORDER.forEach(r => {
      const group = rarityFilter(data, r);
      if(!group.length) return;
      html += `<div class="rar-section">
        <div class="rar-head">
          <div class="rar-stripe" style="background:${RARITY_COLORS[r]}"></div>
          <h3>${RARITY_LABELS[r]}</h3>
          <span class="rar-count">${group.length} carta${group.length!==1?'s':''}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pcards-grid">${group.map(buildCardHTML).join('')}</div>
      </div>`;
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
    return;
  }

  /* ── MODO CARROSSEL ── */
  if(currentViewMode === 'carrossel'){
    let html = '';
    RARITY_ORDER.forEach((r, ri) => {
      const group = rarityFilter(data, r);
      if(!group.length) return;
      group.sort((a,b) => getCardNum(a) - getCardNum(b));
      const trackId = `ctk-${ri}`;
      const cards = group.map(c => {
        const promo = c.promo ? `<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b44cff,#7c3aed);color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;">⭐ PROMO</span>` : '';
        const stock = (c.stock && c.stock > 1) ? `<span style="font-size:.45rem;background:rgba(255,215,0,.15);color:#ffd700;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;">${c.stock}×</span>` : '';
        const _d = (c.detail||'').toLowerCase(); const _dpb = _d.includes('pokebola')||_d.includes('pokébola'); const pokeball = _dpb ? `<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e61010,#ff6b6b);color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">🔴 PB</span>` : ''; const foil = !_dpb && _d.includes('foil') ? `<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c9a000,#f5e67a,#c9a000);color:#3a2000;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">✨ FOIL</span>` : ''; const reverse = !_dpb && !foil && _d.includes('reverse') ? `<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9,#6366f1);color:#fff;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">✦ REVERSE</span>` : '';
        const numMatch = (c.detail || '').match(/^(\d+\/\d+)/);
        const cardNum = numMatch ? `<span class="ctk-num">${numMatch[1]}</span>` : '';
        return `<div class="ctk-card" data-id="${c.id}" data-cname="${c.name}">
          <img src="${c.img}" alt="${c.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="ctkFallback(this)" onclick="openZoom('${c.img}')" style="cursor:zoom-in;">
          <div class="ctk-badges">${promo}${pokeball}${foil}${reverse}${stock}</div>
          <span class="ctk-name">${c.name}${cardNum}</span>
          <span class="ctk-price">R$ ${c.price.toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}</span>
          <button class="ctk-add-btn" onclick="addToCart(${c.id})">+ Carrinho</button>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
      html += `<div class="ctk-section">
        <div class="rar-head">
          <div class="rar-stripe" style="background:${RARITY_COLORS[r]}"></div>
          <h3>${RARITY_LABELS[r]}</h3>
          <span class="rar-count">${group.length} carta${group.length!==1?'s':''}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ctk-wrap">
          <button class="ctk-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('${trackId}').scrollBy({left:-440,behavior:'smooth'})">&#8249;</button>
          <div class="ctk-track" id="${trackId}">${cards}</div>
          <button class="ctk-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('${trackId}').scrollBy({left:440,behavior:'smooth'})">&#8250;</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    });
    container.innerHTML = html;
    /* drag-to-scroll em cada track */
    container.querySelectorAll('.ctk-track').forEach(track => {
      let down=false, sx, sl;
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { down=true; sx=e.pageX-track.offsetLeft; sl=track.scrollLeft; track.style.cursor='grabbing'; });
      track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { down=false; track.style.cursor='grab'; });
      track.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { down=false; track.style.cursor='grab'; });
      track.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if(!down) return; e.preventDefault(); track.scrollLeft=sl-(e.pageX-track.offsetLeft-sx)*1.5; });
    });
    return;
  }

  /* ── MODOS A-Z / PREÇO ── */
  /* lista plana com separadores de coleção */
  const byCol = {};
  data.forEach(c => { (byCol[c.collection] = byCol[c.collection]||[]).push(c); });
  const orderedCols = [...SET_ORDER.filter(s => byCol[s]), ...Object.keys(byCol).filter(s => !SET_ORDER.includes(s))];
  let html = '';
  orderedCols.forEach(col => {
    const group = byCol[col];
    html += `<div class="col-section" style="margin-bottom:2rem;">
      ${setColHeaderHTML(col)}
      <div style="margin-top:1rem;">
        <div class="pcards-grid">${group.map(buildCardHTML).join('')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  });
  container.innerHTML = html;
  // Carrega imagens via API para cartas com apiCard
  loadApiCardImages();
}

function setViewMode(mode, btn){
  currentViewMode = mode;
  /* mapeia para sort interno */
  const sortMap = { colecao:'default', raridade:'default', az:'az', preco:'asc', carrossel:'default' };
  currentSort = sortMap[mode] || 'default';
  document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards(getFiltered());
}

/* navega para aba cartas já filtrada pela coleção do card clicado */
function showTabSet(link){
  const setName = link.closest('[data-set]').dataset.set;
  // muda para aba cartas
  showTab('cartas', document.querySelector('.main-tabs li button[onclick*="cartas"]'));
  // aguarda render e aplica o filtro
  setTimeout(function(){
    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.set-filter-btn'))
      .find(b => b.querySelector('span') && b.querySelector('span').textContent.trim() === setName);
    filterBySet(setName, btn || null);
  }, 50);
}

function filterBySet(setName, btn){
  currentSet = setName;
  document.querySelectorAll('.set-filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards(getFiltered());
}

function sortCards(mode, btn){
  currentSort = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  renderCards(getFiltered());
}

/* ── ABAS PRINCIPAIS ── */
function showTab(id, btn){
  /* Esconde todas as abas */
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-section').forEach(s => {
    s.classList.remove('active');
    s.style.display = '';
  });
  /* Mostra a aba selecionada */
  const sec = document.getElementById('tab-'+id);
  if(sec){
    sec.classList.add('active');
  }
  /* Atualiza nav-links e barra de abas */
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a').forEach(a => {
    const on = a.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
    a.classList.toggle('active', on.includes("'"+id+"'"));
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.main-tabs li button').forEach(b => {
    const on = b.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
    b.classList.toggle('active', on.includes("'"+id+"'"));
  });
  /* Renderiza cartas se for a aba cartas */
  if(id === 'cartas'){
    currentViewMode = 'carrossel';
    currentSort = 'default';
    document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const carBtn = document.getElementById('view-car-btn');
    if(carBtn) carBtn.classList.add('active');
    renderCards(getFiltered());
  }
  /* Ao abrir figurinhas, vai direto para sub-aba avulsas */
  if(id === 'figurinhas'){
    const avulsasBtn = document.querySelector('.fig-subtab[onclick*="avulsas"]');
    showFigSubTab('avulsas', avulsasBtn);
  }
  /* Scroll */
  setTimeout(function(){
    window.scrollTo({top: sec ? Math.max(0, sec.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 130) : 0, behavior:'smooth'});
  }, 60);
}

/* ── FILTRO COLEÇÕES ── */
function filterCol(year, btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.col-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  if(btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#col-grid .col-card').forEach(c => {
    c.style.display = (c.dataset.year === year) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

/* ══════════════ CARRINHO ══════════════ */
let cart = [];

/* ══════════════ FIGURINHAS AVULSAS COPA ══════════════ */

/* Mapa de seleções: código → nome, bandeira e cores para o card visual */
const FIG_SELECOES = {
  'FWC': { nome:'FIFA World Cup',        flag:'⚽', c1:'#0033a0', c2:'#ffd700', txt:'#ffd700', ico:'🏆' },
  'BIH': { nome:'Bósnia e Herzegovina',  flag:'🇧🇦', c1:'#002395', c2:'#fcd116', txt:'#fff',    ico:'⭐' },
  'CZE': { nome:'República Tcheca',      flag:'🇨🇿', c1:'#d7141a', c2:'#11457e', txt:'#fff',    ico:'🦁' },

function getFigCartImg(code) {
  const found = FIGURINHAS_DATA.find(x => x.code === code && x.img);
  if (found) return found.img;
  const s = FIG_SELECOES[code] || { c1:'#013220', c2:'#ffd700' };
  const c1 = encodeURIComponent(s.c1), c2 = encodeURIComponent(s.c2);
  const txt = encodeURIComponent(s.txt || '#fff');
  const ico = encodeURIComponent(s.ico || '⚽');
  return "data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 44 62'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'%3E%3Cstop offset='0' stop-color='" + c1 + "'/%3E%3Cstop offset='1' stop-color='" + c2 + "'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='44' height='62' fill='url(%23g)' rx='4'/%3E%3Crect x='2' y='2' width='40' height='58' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Crect x='0' y='48' width='44' height='14' rx='0' fill='rgba(0,0,0,0.35)'/%3E%3Ctext x='22' y='10' font-family='Arial Black' font-size='6' fill='" + txt + "' text-anchor='middle' font-weight='900'%3E" + encodeURIComponent(code) + "%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='22' y='35' font-size='20' text-anchor='middle'%3E" + ico + "%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='22' y='57' font-family='Arial Black' font-size='5' fill='rgba(255,255,255,0.55)' text-anchor='middle'%3EPANINI%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E";
}

function renderFigCard(f) {
  const s = FIG_SELECOES[f.code] || { c1:'#013220', c2:'#003a8c', txt:'#fff', ico:'⚽', flag:'🌍' };
  const precoFmt = 'R$ ' + f.price.toFixed(2).replace('.',',');
  const label = f.code + ' ' + f.num;
  const descEsc = (f.desc||'').replace(/'/g,"&#39;");
  const imgHtml = f.img
    ? `<img src="${f.img}" class="fig-av-photo" alt="${label}">`
    : `<div class="fig-av-img-top">${f.code}</div><div class="fig-av-img-ico">${s.ico}</div><div class="fig-av-img-num">${f.num}</div><div class="fig-av-img-bot">PANINI</div>`;
  const bgStyle = f.img ? '' : `style="background:linear-gradient(160deg,${s.c1},${s.c2});"`;
  const clickAttr = f.img ? `onclick="openFigLightbox(this.querySelector('img').src,'${label}','${descEsc}')" ` : '';
  return `
    <div class="fig-av-card">
      <div class="fig-av-img${f.img?' has-photo':''}" ${bgStyle}${clickAttr}>${imgHtml}</div>
      <div class="fig-av-num">${f.code} ${f.num}</div>
      <div class="fig-av-desc">${f.desc||''}</div>
      <div class="fig-av-price">${precoFmt}</div>
      <button class="fig-av-btn" onclick="addFigurinhaToCart(${f.id})">🛒 Carrinho</button>
    </div>`;
}

function renderFigurinhasAvulsas() {
  const container = document.getElementById('fig-avulsas-container');
  if (!container) return;
  const grupos = {}, ordemCodigos = [];
  FIGURINHAS_DATA.forEach(f => {
    if (!grupos[f.code]) { grupos[f.code] = []; ordemCodigos.push(f.code); }
    grupos[f.code].push(f);
  });
  ordemCodigos.sort((a,b) => {
    if (a === 'FWC') return -1;
    if (b === 'FWC') return 1;
    const na = (FIG_SELECOES[a]||{nome:a}).nome;
    const nb = (FIG_SELECOES[b]||{nome:b}).nome;
    return na.localeCompare(nb, 'pt');
  });
  ordemCodigos.forEach(c => grupos[c].sort((a,b) => a.num - b.num));
  container.innerHTML = ordemCodigos.map(code => {
    const sel = FIG_SELECOES[code] || { nome:code, flag:'🌍' };
    const items = grupos[code];
    return `
      <div class="fig-grupo">
        <div class="fig-grupo-head">
          <span class="fig-grupo-flag">${sel.flag}</span>
          <span class="fig-grupo-nome">${sel.nome} (${code})</span>
          <span class="fig-grupo-qtd">${items.length} figurinha${items.length>1?'s':''}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="fig-av-grid">${items.map(renderFigCard).join('')}</div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function addFigurinhaToCart(figId) {
  const fig = FIGURINHAS_DATA.find(f => f.id === figId);
  if (!fig) return;
  const label = fig.code + ' ' + fig.num;
  const existing = cart.find(i => i.id === figId);
  if (existing) { existing.qty++; }
  else { cart.push({ id:figId, name:'Figurinha ' + label, num:'', price:fig.price, img:fig.img || getFigCartImg(fig.code), qty:1 }); }
  updateCartUI();
  showCartToast('Figurinha ' + label + ' adicionada');
}

function showFigSubTab(panel, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fig-subpanel').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.fig-subtab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  const el = document.getElementById('fig-sub-' + panel);
  if (el) el.style.display = '';
  if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');
  if (panel === 'avulsas') renderFigurinhasAvulsas();
}

/* ── FIGURINHAS COPA ── */
const STICKER_ID = 9001;
let stickerQty = 1;
const STICKER_IMG = "data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 60'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='sg' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'%3E%3Cstop offset='0%25' stop-color='%23003d1a'/%3E%3Cstop offset='100%25' stop-color='%23003a8c'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='40' height='60' fill='url(%23sg)' rx='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='20' y='37' font-size='22' text-anchor='middle'%3E%E2%9A%BD%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='20' y='50' font-family='Arial Black' font-weight='900' font-size='8' fill='%23ffd700' text-anchor='middle'%3E2026%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E";

/* ── controles da promo home ── */
let homeStickerQty = 1;
function changeHomeStickerQty(delta) {
  homeStickerQty = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, homeStickerQty + delta));
  const el = document.getElementById('home-sticker-qty');
  if (el) el.textContent = homeStickerQty;
  const tel = document.getElementById('home-sticker-total');
  if (tel) tel.textContent = 'R$ ' + (homeStickerQty * 6.50).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}
function addHomeStickerToCart() {
  const existing = cart.find(i => i.id === STICKER_ID);
  if (existing) { existing.qty += homeStickerQty; }
  else { cart.push({ id: STICKER_ID, name: 'Pacotinho Figurinhas Copa 2026', num: '', price: 6.50, img: STICKER_IMG, qty: homeStickerQty }); }
  updateCartUI();
  showCartToast('Pacotinho Copa 2026 ×' + homeStickerQty);
  homeStickerQty = 1;
  const el = document.getElementById('home-sticker-qty');
  if (el) el.textContent = '1';
  const tel = document.getElementById('home-sticker-total');
  if (tel) tel.textContent = 'R$ 6,50';
}

function changeStickerQty(delta) {
  stickerQty = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, stickerQty + delta));
  const el = document.getElementById('sticker-qty-val');
  if (el) el.textContent = stickerQty;
  const tel = document.getElementById('sticker-total-val');
  if (tel) tel.textContent = 'R$ ' + (stickerQty * 6.50).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}

function addStickerToCart() {
  const existing = cart.find(i => i.id === STICKER_ID);
  if (existing) {
    existing.qty += stickerQty;
  } else {
    cart.push({ id: STICKER_ID, name: 'Pacotinho Figurinhas Copa 2026', num: '', price: 6.50, img: STICKER_IMG, qty: stickerQty });
  }
  updateCartUI();
  showCartToast('Pacotinho Copa 2026 ×' + stickerQty);
  stickerQty = 1;
  const el = document.getElementById('sticker-qty-val');
  if (el) el.textContent = '1';
  const tel = document.getElementById('sticker-total-val');
  if (tel) tel.textContent = 'R$ 6,50';
}

function addToCart(cardId) {
  const card = CARDS_DATA.find(c => c.id === cardId);
  if (!card) return;
  const existing = cart.find(i => i.id === cardId);
  if (existing) {
    existing.qty++;
  } else {
    const nm = (card.detail || '').match(/^(\d+\/\d+)/);
    cart.push({id: card.id, name: card.name, num: nm ? nm[1] : '', price: card.price, img: card.img, qty: 1});
  }
  updateCartUI();
  showCartToast(card.name);
}

function removeFromCart(cardId) {
  cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== cardId);
  updateCartUI();
}

function changeQty(cardId, delta) {
  const item = cart.find(i => i.id === cardId);
  if (!item) return;
  item.qty += delta;
  if (item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== cardId);
  updateCartUI();
}

function updateCartUI() {
  const total = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  const count = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);

  /* badge */
  const badge = document.getElementById('cart-badge');
  if (badge) { badge.textContent = count; badge.style.display = count > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none'; }

  /* total */
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('cart-total-val');
  if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = 'R$ ' + total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');

  /* botão enviar */
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('cart-send-btn');
  if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = cart.length === 0;

  /* lista */
  const itemsEl = document.getElementById('cart-items');
  if (!itemsEl) return;
  if (cart.length === 0) {
    itemsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty">Carrinho vazio.<br>Adicione cartas ou pacotinhos de figurinhas.</div>';
    return;
  }
  itemsEl.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <img src="${item.img}" alt="${item.name}" onerror="this.style.opacity='.3'">
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <span class="cart-item-name">${item.name}${item.num ? `<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-left:4px;">${item.num}</span>` : ''}</span>
        <span class="cart-item-price">R$ ${(item.price * item.qty).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cart-item-qty">
        <button onclick="changeQty(${item.id},-1)">−</button>
        <span>${item.qty}</span>
        <button onclick="changeQty(${item.id},1)">+</button>
      </div>
      <button class="cart-item-remove" onclick="removeFromCart(${item.id})" title="Remover">✕</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function openCart() {
  document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeCart() {
  document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

function showCartToast(name) {
  const t = document.getElementById('cart-toast');
  if (!t) return;
  t.textContent = '✓ ' + name + ' adicionado';
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(t._timer);
  t._timer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
}

function sendWhatsApp() {
  if (cart.length === 0) return;
  const total = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  const lines = cart.map(i =>
    '• ' + i.name + (i.num ? ' ' + i.num : '') + (i.qty > 1 ? ' (' + i.qty + '×)' : '') +
    ' — R$ ' + (i.price * i.qty).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')
  ).join('\n');
  const msg =
    'Olá! Gostaria de fazer um pedido:\n\n' +
    lines +
    '\n\n*Total: R$ ' + total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') + '*' +
    '\n\nAguardo confirmação! 🙂';
  window.open('https://wa.me/5517992709588?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg), '_blank');
}

/* ── INIT ── */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  /* normalizar raridades automaticamente pelo campo detail */
  CARDS_DATA.forEach(function(c){
    const parts = (c.detail || '').split(' · ');
    const code  = (parts[1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if      (code === 'HR')                      c.rarity = 'hr';
    else if (code === 'SIR' || code === 'SR')    c.rarity = 'sr';
    else if (code === 'UR'  || code === 'FULL ART') c.rarity = 'ur';
    else if (code === 'IR'  || code === 'AR')    c.rarity = 'ir';
    else if (code === 'DR'  || code === 'RR')    c.rarity = 'rr';
    else if (code === 'R')                       c.rarity = 'r';
    else if (code === 'U')                       c.rarity = 'u';
    else if (code === 'C')                       c.rarity = 'c';
  });

  /* mostrar todas as coleções sem filtro de ano */
  document.querySelectorAll('#col-grid .col-card').forEach(c => c.style.display = '');
  renderCards(getFiltered());
  loadApiCardImages();
  /* stat dinâmica: total de cartas no site */
  const statEl = document.getElementById('stat-cards');
  if(statEl) statEl.textContent = CARDS_DATA.length;
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CALCULADORA DE FRETE — Correios 2025
//  Origem: SP Interior (DDD 17 · Bauru / Lins region)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

var _freteQtyLevel = 1; // 1=1-5 | 2=6-20 | 3=21-50 | 4=51+

function freteMaskCep(el) {
  var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g,'');
  if (v.length > 5) v = v.slice(0,5) + '-' + v.slice(5,8);
  el.value = v;
  if (v.replace('-','').length === 8) calcularFrete();
}

function setFreteQty(btn, level) {
  _freteQtyLevel = level;
  document.querySelectorAll('.frete-qty-btn').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('active'); });
  btn.classList.add('active');
  // Recalcula se já há resultado na tela
  var cep = (document.getElementById('frete-cep').value||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if (cep.length === 8) calcularFrete();
}

// Zonas por estado (a partir de SP Interior)
// Z1=SP · Z2=MG,RJ,ES · Z3=PR,SC,RS · Z4=GO,MS,MT,DF · Z5=Nordeste · Z6=Norte
var _FRETE_ZONE = {
  'SP':1,
  'MG':2,'RJ':2,'ES':2,
  'PR':3,'SC':3,'RS':3,
  'GO':4,'MS':4,'MT':4,'DF':4,
  'BA':5,'SE':5,'AL':5,'PE':5,'PB':5,'RN':5,'CE':5,'PI':5,'MA':5,
  'AM':6,'PA':6,'AC':6,'RO':6,'RR':6,'AP':6,'TO':6
};

// Preços PAC (R$) indexados por [nível_qtd][zona-1]
// Base: tabela Correios 2025 · SP interior como origem
var _PAC = [
  [18.40, 21.30, 24.60, 27.80, 32.50, 38.90],  // 1-5 cartas  (~120g, envelope bolha)
  [23.10, 26.80, 31.20, 35.40, 41.20, 49.80],  // 6-20 cartas (~350g, caixa pequena)
  [27.90, 32.50, 37.80, 43.10, 50.30, 60.70],  // 21-50 cartas (~700g)
  [36.20, 42.40, 49.80, 57.30, 67.40, 81.60]   // 51+ cartas   (~1.5kg)
];

// Preços SEDEX (R$) indexados por [nível_qtd][zona-1]
var _SEDEX = [
  [23.80, 28.50, 33.20, 39.40, 47.80, 57.60],
  [30.20, 36.40, 42.80, 51.20, 62.70, 75.90],
  [37.50, 45.10, 53.20, 63.80, 78.40, 95.20],
  [48.90, 59.20, 70.40, 84.60,104.30,127.80]
];

// Prazo estimado em dias úteis [zona-1]
var _PAC_DIAS   = ['3–5','4–6','5–8','7–10','8–12','10–15'];
var _SEDEX_DIAS = ['1–2','1–2','2–3', '2–3', '3–4',  '4–5'];

var _ZONE_LABEL = ['SP','SP+MG+RJ+ES','Sul','Centro-Oeste','Nordeste','Norte'];

async function calcularFrete() {
  var cep = (document.getElementById('frete-cep').value||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
  if (cep.length !== 8) return;

  var result = document.getElementById('frete-result');
  result.style.display = 'block';
  result.innerHTML = '<div class="frete-loading">🔍 Consultando CEP…</div>';

  try {
    var res = await fetch('https://brasilapi.com.br/api/cep/v2/' + cep);
    if (!res.ok) {
      // Fallback: tenta ViaCEP
      var res2 = await fetch('https://viacep.com.br/ws/' + cep + '/json/');
      var d2 = await res2.json();
      if (d2.erro) throw new Error('not found');
      var data = { state: d2.uf, city: d2.localidade, neighborhood: d2.bairro, street: d2.logradouro, cep: cep.slice(0,5)+'-'+cep.slice(5) };
    } else {
      var data = await res.json();
    }

    var state = (data.state||data.uf||'').toUpperCase();
    var city  = data.city || data.localidade || '';
    var zone  = _FRETE_ZONE[state] || 5;
    var zi    = zone - 1;

    var lvl      = _freteQtyLevel - 1;
    var pacVal   = _PAC[lvl][zi];
    var sedexVal = _SEDEX[lvl][zi];
    var pacDias  = _PAC_DIAS[zi];
    var sedexDias= _SEDEX_DIAS[zi];

    var qtyLabel = ['1–5 cartas','6–20 cartas','21–50 cartas','51+ cartas'][lvl];
    var fmt = function(v){ return 'R$ ' + v.toFixed(2).replace('.',','); };

    result.innerHTML =
      '<div class="frete-dest">' +
        '<span class="frete-pin">📍</span>' +
        '<div>' +
          '<strong>' + city + ' &nbsp;–&nbsp; ' + state + '</strong>' +
          '<small>CEP ' + (data.cep || cep.slice(0,5)+'-'+cep.slice(5)) + (data.neighborhood ? ' · ' + data.neighborhood : '') + '</small>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="frete-options">' +
        '<div class="frete-opt pac">' +
          '<div class="frete-opt-header">' +
            '<span class="frete-opt-logo">📦</span>' +
            '<div>' +
              '<div class="frete-opt-name">PAC <span class="frete-opt-tag">Econômico</span></div>' +
              '<div class="frete-opt-desc">' + qtyLabel + ' · Correios</div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="frete-opt-right">' +
            '<div class="frete-opt-price">' + fmt(pacVal) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="frete-opt-days">⏱ ' + pacDias + ' dias úteis</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="frete-opt sedex">' +
          '<div class="frete-opt-header">' +
            '<span class="frete-opt-logo">⚡</span>' +
            '<div>' +
              '<div class="frete-opt-name">SEDEX <span class="frete-opt-tag">Expresso</span></div>' +
              '<div class="frete-opt-desc">' + qtyLabel + ' · Correios</div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="frete-opt-right">' +
            '<div class="frete-opt-price">' + fmt(sedexVal) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="frete-opt-days">⏱ ' + sedexDias + ' dias úteis</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="frete-note">* Estimativa baseada na tabela dos Correios 2025 a partir de SP Interior. ' +
        'O valor exato é confirmado no momento do envio. Sleeve + top loader incluídos em todos os pedidos.</div>';

  } catch(e) {
    result.innerHTML =
      '<div class="frete-error">❌ CEP não encontrado. Verifique o número e tente novamente.<br>' +
      '<a href="https://buscacepinter.correios.com.br/app/endereco/index.php" target="_blank" ' +
      'style="color:#fbbf24;font-size:.65rem;">→ Buscar CEP no site dos Correios</a></div>';
  }
}
</script>

<!-- ══ LIGHTBOX FIGURINHAS ══ -->
<div id="fig-lightbox">
  <div class="lb-inner">
    <button class="lb-close" onclick="closeFigLightbox()" title="Fechar">✕</button>
    <img id="lb-img" class="lb-img" src="" alt="">
    <div id="lb-info" class="lb-info"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="lb-backdrop" onclick="closeFigLightbox()"></div>
</div>
<script>
function openFigLightbox(src, label, desc) {
  const lb = document.getElementById('fig-lightbox');
  document.getElementById('lb-img').src = src;
  document.getElementById('lb-info').innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong>' + (desc ? '<br>' + desc : '');
  lb.classList.add('open');
  document.addEventListener('keydown', lbKeyClose);
}
function closeFigLightbox() {
  document.getElementById('fig-lightbox').classList.remove('open');
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', lbKeyClose);
  setTimeout(function(){ document.getElementById('lb-img').src = ''; }, 200);
}
function lbKeyClose(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeFigLightbox(); }
</script>
</body>
</html>
